propositions: The Python public-API surface must be guarded by a portable, test-linked drift gate that detects removed/renamed symbols and changed signatures without external dependencies (griffe)
A committed baseline JSON snapshot captures the current public surface (union of pinned MODULES' __all__ or owned non-underscore attributes) and is updated via scripts/gen_api_surface.py --update
The hardcoded-subset surface assertions in test_reuse_surface_doc.py must be subsumed by automated full-surface checking with equivalent or better coverage proof
The gate must run under make test with no CI-provider dependency, using only stdlib introspection (inspect/importlib), and report clear drift with remediation guidance
Intentional surface changes must be accommodatable via the --update path, and unintended drift must be caught immediately with exit code 1 and named diff output
